to `hass.config.components` to ensure signals are

    hass.data[NOTIFY_DISCOVERY_DISPATCHER] = discovery.async_listen_platform(

issue_context.title: notify.mobile_app_xxx is missing
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Since I updated HA from version 2022.6.7 to version 2022.8.0, the notify.mobile_app_ (myphone) service disappears when I start / restart HA and the smartphone is not detected at that moment (deep sleep or poor wifi signal).
Before, the notification service was always available even if my mobile phone was turned off.
I checked the changelog of the versions 2022.7.x and that of the version 2022.8.0 but I have not found any changes in this regard.
Now I have to restart HA and make sure I have my mobile active with a good signal if I want the notification service to appear.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant 2022.8.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

Home Assistant 2022.6.7

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Supervised

### Integration causing the issue

App per dispositivi mobili

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/mobile_app

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

Would it be possible that when the smartphone becomes reachable HA makes an attempt to recover the notify.mobile_app_xxx service without forcing me to check if the service is loaded or not?
I have some automations that rely on cell phone notifications that now go wrong with me.
comments:
Hey there @home-assistant/core, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`mobile_app`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L659) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Which mobile app are you using? There is no dependency on the device being online to register the service. There may be errors in the logs. Also check if the device is still registered to the integration.

I am using Home Assistant Mobile App v2022-6.0-full for Android.
My smartphone model is the Xiaomi Redmi Note 4 with Android 7.0 NRD90M.
The only error in the logs is the one that tells me the lack of the notification service, the error is the following:
`Logger: homeassistant.components.script.multinotify3`
`Source: helpers/script.py:1063`
`Integration: Script (documentation, issues)`
`First occurred: 20:14:03 (1 occurrences)`
`Last logged: 20:14:03`

`Notifica intelligente: Error executing script. Service not found for choose at pos 1: Unable to find service` `notify.mobile_app_redmi_note_4`

I have been using different automations that are based on smartphone notifications for some time and everything has always worked up to the version of HA 2022.6.7, then I switched to 2022.8.0 and I started having that error for each automation that called the service of notification.
The device is regularly registered in the integration and even if I try to reload the integration the notification service does not reappear.
The rest of the cell phone sensors are detected and updated regularly.
I just updated HA to version 2022.8.2 but nothing has changed.
Check that the device is still registered. Settings > Devices & Services > Mobile App

Yes, it is duly registered.
I had just updated the comment above!
ok sounds like something may have been corrupted. Try these steps in order: https://companion.home-assistant.io/docs/troubleshooting/faqs/#starting-fresh-with-the-android-app

I'm having the same issue with the iOS app installed on mine and other's devices in my household. The furthest I've been able to get with troubleshooting is to find out that it impacts all the devices, and the `notify.mobile_*` services will all show back up after a restart or two (or three). Seems pretty random from what I've been able to tell thus far.

@dshokouhi GREAT!!!
It worked, now the notification service is back.
I tried to restart HA while keeping the phone offline and the service remained, probably something was corrupted.
Thanks again.
@OneMatt Follow the same advice he gave to me: I followed all the steps in the guide and it worked.

Sorry, I don't think my initial comment was clear, and I managed to use the wrong account 🤦. This impacts _all_ the devices in my household, not just one. And my workaround so far has been to restart home assistant until they show back up.

I spoke too soon!
After the second restart, the notification service disappeared again.
I had to reboot again to make it reappear.
At this point I am back to the original problem, I cannot keep restarting HA and verify that the mobile is online every time I need to use the notification service.
For now I have no errors in the log just because the automations have not used that service yet.
Is there any other verification I can do?

@dshokouhi I restarted a few times with `mobile_app` and `notify` components set to debug to see if there was anything helpful there. Unfortunately all that did was confirm that sometimes it wasn't setting up the mobile app notify service. In both cases I could see what looks like good logs from the `mobile_app` component and the various sensors all updated as usual.

Run without any mobile notify services
```
2022-08-10 07:16:21.999 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.notify] Setting up notify.group
2022-08-10 07:16:22.000 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.notify] Setting up notify.group
2022-08-10 07:16:22.000 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.notify] Setting up notify.group
```

Restart with the services
```
2022-08-10 07:18:20.054 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.notify] Setting up notify.group
2022-08-10 07:18:20.054 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.notify] Setting up notify.group
2022-08-10 07:18:20.055 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.notify] Setting up notify.group
2022-08-10 07:18:20.304 INFO (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.notify] Setting up notify.mobile_app
```

Should I do a full debug run or are there other components I could get logging from?

I am having the same problem with both iOS and Android since moving to 2022.8.0 (and it continues in .3).  Restarting the HOST will sometimes get them back, but then restarting HA through the web UI will make them disappear again.  Not seeing anything in the logs for the companion apps, nor the main log that looks like it is related - other than automations reporting the service is invalid.  The apps are reporting data, it is just that the notify services are not always being created and I can find no evidence as to why...

It's possibly a more general notify service problem, these could be related:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/76564 
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/76343

I too have noticed this issue for all notification services, except the persistent notification which seems to set up fine every time. Also noticed from 2022.08, including the beta when thinking about it.
